title: Console: Rebaseline 'Insight Lenses' MVP — trim telemetry and emphasize actionability
creator: Aisha Patel
description: This ticket captures a scoped-down MVP for the Console insights surface (dashboards + tracing + per-route cost breakdown) focused on surfacing high-actionability signals while reducing telemetry and compute cost. The prior scope attempted to ship a broad set of cards and deep trace exploration; we will cut non-actionable visuals, remove per-token heatmaps, and defer sampling-based tracing to a later iteration. The goal is a minimal, testable surface that meets latency and cost targets while giving product teams clear next steps to remediate regressions.
background: During alpha reviews we discovered two key problems: 1) too many low-signal cards created noise and lengthened load times, and 2) the initial trace sampling approach required high storage and frontend complexity. Finance flagged potential cost overruns if we shipped full per-token traces and dense telemetry retention. PM and Eng agreed to prioritize actionability: top-line route-level cost deltas, a single aggregated trace preview for failing routes, and a compact set of dashboard cards tied to concrete runbooks.
decision_log:
2025-03-12: Cut per-token heatmap and latency flamegraphs from MVP; retain single aggregated flame preview.
2025-03-13: Endorse 'Actionability Score' as primary sorting metric for insight cards.
2025-03-15: Defer heavy-weight trace sampling (full traces at 100% capture) to post-MVP; implement deterministic sampling + sparse KV cache pointers for preview.
2025-03-18: Lock acceptance criteria and performance SLA for dashboard load under 1.5s for 95th percentile on typical org with <= 500 routes.
scope_in: Compact dashboard view: 6 high-priority cards (route cost delta, error rate delta, median latency delta, top 5 error messages, active routes by traffic, cost per 1k tokens)
Actionability Score: computed from cost delta, error delta, and recent rollouts; used to sort cards
Per-route cost breakdown: summary table + links to cost explorer (no deep token-level breakdown)
Tracing: aggregated trace preview for top 3 failing routes with single-click link to start full-capture workflow
Rollout guard UI: flag routes with rollout-related regressions and provide quick rollback/redeploy checklist
Acceptance tests and synthetic traffic harness for performance verification
Console telemetry gating: sample rate controls and aggregated retention defaults to minimize cost
scope_out: Per-token cost heatmaps and dense token-level visualizations
Full trace capture and long-term storage for all routes
Custom dashboard card builder for initial MVP (deferred to phase 2)
Advanced correlation panels (correlate external metrics or APM spans)
Per-tenant deep-cost attribution breakdowns beyond route-level summaries
Real-time streaming of trace spans into the UI (deferred)
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard load time: median < 700ms and p95 < 1.5s for orgs with <= 500 routes under standard test harness
Actionability: at least 4 of the 6 cards include a documented remediation step or runbook link
Cost delta accuracy: per-route cost delta within ±7% compared to batched billing export over a 24h window
Tracing preview: aggregated trace preview for failing route renders within 1s and links to full-capture workflow
Sampling controls: org-level sample rate can be set to 0.5%, 1%, 5% via console and observed in telemetry within 5 minutes
E2E smoke tests: synthetic traffic triggers insights and acceptance tests pass in CI with no flaky failures > 5%
Security: no new secrets displayed in console and access respects existing RBAC roles
Cost guard: estimated incremental monthly telemetry cost for MVP < $5k for median customer profile
metrics: Primary: % of flagged insights that lead to an explicit user action within 7 days (target >= 18%)
Performance: dashboard p95 load time target < 1.5s
Cost: incremental telemetry cost vs baseline (target < $5k/month median)
Adoption: number of orgs that enable the insights surface in first 30 days (target >= 25% of early adopters)
rollout_plan: Staged rollout: 1) internal dogfood across Platform and Core infra teams for 2 weeks; 2) opt-in beta for 10 pilot customers (selected by CS) for 2 weeks; 3) gradual enable 10% -> 50% -> 100% across orgs with monitoring thresholds for cost and error to pause rollout. Each stage includes post-stage retro and a go/no-go checklist for performance and cost impact.
dependencies: ENG-40211: telemetry sampling API (blocking for sampling UI)
ENG-41602: dashboard card server-side aggregation endpoints
DES-2210: compact card visual design and action affordances
PM-82412: cost-export schema stabilization (for delta calculations)
Security: RBAC review and minor console privileges update
risks: Underestimating cost of trace previews if previews trigger backend replays; mitigation: rate-limit previews and cache lightweight summaries
Actionability Score may bias toward noisy but low-impact routes; mitigation: manually tune weights and run calibration against historical incidents
Performance regressions for large orgs (> 1k routes) — MVP targets are scoped to <= 500 routes; mitigation: add graceful degradation and placeholder cards for larger orgs
User confusion if deep features are missing; mitigation: clear messaging in UI about 'MVP surface' and links to request features
notes: Preference is for server-side aggregation over heavy client rendering to keep frontend CPU low. Design suggested progressive disclosure: show compact card then expand to preview. Finance requested telemetry cost simulation during beta; schedule integration with billing reports. Keep full-capture trace workflow gated behind customer opt-in and extra data retention agreement.
